legend: Gaurang has grown up in a mystical universe. He is faced by n$$$n$$$ consecutive 2D planes. He shoots a particle of decay age k$$$k$$$ at the planes.

A particle can pass through a plane directly, however, every plane produces an identical copy of the particle going in the opposite direction with a decay age k−1$$$k-1$$$. If a particle has decay age equal to 1$$$1$$$, it will NOT produce a copy.

For example, if there are two planes and a particle is shot with decay age 3$$$3$$$ (towards the right), the process is as follows: (here, D(x)$$$D(x)$$$ refers to a single particle with decay age x$$$x$$$)
the first plane produces a D(2)$$$D(2)$$$ to the left and lets D(3)$$$D(3)$$$ continue on to the right;
the second plane produces a D(2)$$$D(2)$$$ to the left and lets D(3)$$$D(3)$$$ continue on to the right;
the first plane lets D(2)$$$D(2)$$$ continue on to the left and produces a D(1)$$$D(1)$$$ to the right;
the second plane lets D(1)$$$D(1)$$$ continue on to the right (D(1)$$$D(1)$$$ cannot produce any copies).
In total, the final multiset S$$$S$$$ of particles is {D(3),D(2),D(2),D(1)}$$$\{D(3), D(2), D(2), D(1)\}$$$. (See notes for visual explanation of this test case.)
Gaurang is unable to cope up with the complexity of this situation when the number of planes is too large. Help Gaurang find the size of the multiset S$$$S$$$, given n$$$n$$$ and k$$$k$$$.
Since the size of the multiset can be very large, you have to output it modulo 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$.
Note: Particles can go back and forth between the planes without colliding with each other.
input: The first line of the input contains the number of test cases t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤100$$$1 \le t \le 100$$$). Then, t$$$t$$$ lines follow, each containing two integers n$$$n$$$ and k$$$k$$$ (1≤n,k≤1000$$$1 \le n, k \le 1000$$$).

Additionally, the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases will not exceed 1000$$$1000$$$, and the sum of k$$$k$$$ over all test cases will not exceed 1000$$$1000$$$. All test cases in one test are different.
output: Output t$$$t$$$ integers. The i$$$i$$$-th of them should be equal to the answer to the i$$$i$$$-th test case.
note: Let us explain the first example with four test cases.
Test case 1: (n=2$$$n = 2$$$, k=3$$$k = 3$$$) is already explained in the problem statement.

See the below figure of this simulation. Each straight line with a different color represents the path of a different particle. As you can see, there are four distinct particles in the multiset. Note that the vertical spacing between reflected particles is for visual clarity only (as mentioned before, no two distinct particles collide with each other)
Test case 2: (n=2$$$n = 2$$$, k=2$$$k = 2$$$) is explained as follows:
the first plane produces a D(1)$$$D(1)$$$ to the left and lets D(2)$$$D(2)$$$ continue on to the right;
the second plane produces a D(1)$$$D(1)$$$ to the left and lets D(2)$$$D(2)$$$ continue on to the right;
the first plane lets D(1)$$$D(1)$$$ continue on to the left (D(1)$$$D(1)$$$ cannot produce any copies).
Total size of multiset obtained {D(1),D(1),D(2)}$$$\{D(1), D(1), D(2)\}$$$ is equal to three.

Test case 3: (n=3$$$n = 3$$$, k=1$$$k = 1$$$), there are three planes, but decay age is only one. So no new copies are produced while the one particle passes through the planes. Hence, the answer is one.
Test case 4: (n=1$$$n = 1$$$, k=3$$$k = 3$$$) there is only one plane. The particle produces a new copy to the left. The multiset {D(2),D(3)}$$$\{D(2), D(3)\}$$$ is of size two.

legend.ai: Gaurang 在一个神秘的宇宙中长大。他面对着 n$$$n$$$ 个连续的二维平面。他向这些平面发射了一个衰变年龄为 k$$$k$$$ 的粒子。
粒子可以直接穿过一个平面，但是每个平面都会产生一个沿相反方向运动的完全相同的粒子，其衰变年龄为 k−1$$$k-1$$$。如果粒子的衰变年龄等于 1$$$1$$$，它将不会产生复制体。
例如，如果有两个平面，并且向右发射一个衰变年龄为 3$$$3$$$ 的粒子，过程如下：(这里，D(x)$$$D(x)$$$ 表示一个衰变年龄为 x$$$x$$$ 的粒子)
第一个平面向左产生一个 D(2)$$$D(2)$$$，并让 D(3)$$$D(3)$$$ 继续向右运动；
第二个平面在左侧产生一个 D(2)$$$D(2)$$$，并让 D(3)$$$D(3)$$$ 继续向右移动；
第一个平面让 D(2)$$$D(2)$$$ 继续向左移动，并在右侧产生一个 D(1)$$$D(1)$$$；
第二个平面让 D(1)$$$D(1)$$$ 继续向右移动(D(1)$$$D(1)$$$ 无法产生任何副本)。
最终，粒子的多重集合 S$$$S$$$ 为 {D(3),D(2),D(2),D(1)}$$$\{D(3), D(2), D(2), D(1)\}$$$。(有关此测试用例的图示解释，请参见注释。)
当平面数量过多时，Gaurang 无法应对这种情况的复杂性。给定 n$$$n$$$ 和 k$$$k$$$，请帮助 Gaurang 求出多重集合 S$$$S$$$ 的大小。
由于多重集合的大小可能非常大，你需要输出其对 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$ 取模的结果。
注意：粒子可以在平面之间来回移动，且彼此不会发生碰撞。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含测试用例数量 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤100$$$1 \le t \le 100$$$)。接下来有 t$$$t$$$ 行，每行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 k$$$k$$$(1≤n,k≤1000$$$1 \le n, k \le 1000$$$)。
此外，所有测试用例中 n$$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 1000$$$1000$$$，k$$$k$$$ 的总和不超过 1000$$$1000$$$。同一组测试中的所有测试用例均不相同。

output.ai: 输出 t$$$t$$$ 个整数。其中第 i$$$i$$$ 个整数应等于第 i$$$i$$$ 个测试用例的答案。

note.ai: 下面我们解释第一个样例中的四个测试用例。
请看下面这幅关于该模拟的图。每条颜色不同的直线表示一个不同粒子的路径。正如你所看到的，多重集中有四个互不相同的粒子。注意，反射粒子之间的垂直间距仅用于视觉上的清晰展示（如前文所述，任意两个不同的粒子都不会相撞）。
第一个平面向左产生一个 D(1)$$$D(1)$$$，并让 D(2)$$$D(2)$$$ 继续向右运动；
第二个平面向左产生一个 D(1)$$$D(1)$$$，并让 D(2)$$$D(2)$$$ 继续向右运动；
第一个平面让 D(1)$$$D(1)$$$ 继续向左运动(D(1)$$$D(1)$$$ 无法产生任何副本)。
测试用例 3：(n=3$$$n = 3$$$，k=1$$$k = 1$$$)，共有三个平面，但衰减年龄只有 1。因此，当这一个粒子穿过这些平面时，不会产生新的副本。因此，答案为 1。
测试用例 4：(n=1$$$n = 1$$$，k=3$$$k = 3$$$)，只有一个平面。该粒子向左产生一个新的副本。多重集合 {D(2),D(3)}$$$\{D(2), D(3)\}$$$ 的大小为 2。
